title: The EU taxes cheap parcels from China – level 2
paragraphs: The EU starts charging a new 3-euro fee on cheap packages from China. This new rule targets popular online shops like Shein, Temu, and AliExpress.

Before this change, these companies didn’t pay import taxes on cheap goods, which helped them sell products at very low prices and grow fast. But European businesses complained that this was unfair. The number of small packages that entered Europe grew from 1.4 billion to 5.8 billion in 2025.

Politicians say that Chinese companies abused the old rules. Now, buyers must pay 3 euros for each type of item in a box. For example, a parcel with three different types of items will cost 9 euros. The United States also started a similar tax on Chinese goods earlier this year to help US companies.
